convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to load a custom indicator 'ADX_Smoothed' which is not a built-in MT5 indicator, and depends on external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library for all trade execution logic including position sizing, opening, and closing.

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars before EA starts trading
TimeShiftSec - chart period in seconds
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime calculation for position open functions

other_exits: Opposite signal closes existing position: sell signal closes long (BUY_Close), buy signal closes short (SELL_Close), gated by BuyPosClose and SellPosClose input booleans

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MM input parameter: negative values are treated as fixed lot size (e.g. -0.1 means 0.1 lots), positive values are treated as share of deposit in a deal (risk fraction). Logic handled inside TradeAlgorithms.mqh.

custom_logic_notes: Entry uses a two-bar crossover confirmation: DiPlus[1]>DiMinus[1] (previous bar DI+ above DI-) AND DiPlus[0]<=DiMinus[0] (current signal bar had DI+ below or equal DI-, i.e. crossover just happened). SignalBar input controls which bar index is used for signal detection (default bar 1). Trade execution and position management (open/close/position checks) are entirely encapsulated in TradeAlgorithms.mqh library functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, GlobalVariableDel_) - their internal logic is not visible in this file. UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime are passed to position open functions and may be used for stop-limit timing or pending order expiry inside the library.
python_conversion_notes: The core crossover logic (DI+ crossing DI-) is straightforward to replicate. However, the ADX_Smoothed custom indicator must be reverse-engineered or reimplemented in Python - it uses two alpha smoothing parameters (0.25, 0.33) on top of standard ADX DI+/DI- values. The TradeAlgorithms.mqh library handles all order execution, position checking, money management (conditional lot sizing based on MM sign), and global variable cleanup - these must be reimplemented. The conditional MM logic (negative=lot, positive=deposit fraction) needs careful handling. Deviation parameter (10 points) maps to slippage control. Signal time tracking (UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime) likely used for order expiration or bar-aligned entry timing within the library. No digit adjustment is performed in this EA itself - it may be handled inside TradeAlgorithms.mqh.
